note: Derived from one machine’s live profile, which is not in this repository. sourceDigest folds only the layer files whose real path is inside this repository (a bundle reached through a junction into plugins/ counts here, so a repository change moves it); liveDigest folds the inputs this machine owns — the profile’s own cordis.patch.yml and bundles installed outside the repository — and is recorded rather than gated, because the app rewrites its own profile patch (R40, R43). --check compares the report without the live section.
liveDigestIs: the machine’s own profile patch and out-of-repository bundles: recorded, never a gate criterion
limits: Home and command-line overlays are not read: they apply after the profile layer and can replace any claim below.
A row target is matched by id text alone; whether the id is reached at runtime (group nesting, disabled carriers, !!js) is not evaluated.
